project_registration_format.$comment: The generation of this registration contract a framework must understand, not the bytes of the file that states it. Editing this schema's prose is not a new generation and must not move the registration root of a project already published against it.

observed_instance_identity_schema_hashes.$comment: The closed set of observed-instance identity schema documents this registration owns, as the sha256 of each exact document. The deployment names the documents and the loader derives every digest from the bytes it read, sorted and unique by that derivation -- JSON Schema cannot state sortedness, so the framework's own reading of the derived document refuses any other order. The documents' absolute $ids are not restated here: the compiled authority reads each from the bytes this member pins, which is why a validator for bytes outside this set cannot be added without moving project_registration_hash.

project_tool_bindings.$comment: The Project Tool binding table: one row per Tool this registration binds to a closure entry point. It sits beside tool_catalog_hash rather than inside the catalog because a binding is the join of a contract name and a code entry, and a catalog carrying it could no longer be served to a caller and verified against the pinned digest. It is inside this root because a re-registration that rebound a Tool to different code without moving project_registration_hash would leave the pinned environment no longer pinning which code answers a call. Sorted and unique by tool_name -- JSON Schema cannot state sortedness, so the framework's own reading refuses any other order. An empty array is a registration that binds no Tool.
